_comment: Example localStorage seed for tools/shoot.js — pass with --seed=tools/seed.example.json.
Every number here is INVENTED so the screenshots have something to draw.
Real physiology never enters this repo (CLAUDE.md §4.10); tests/build.test.js
keeps an allowlist that fails the suite if it does. Copy this file, edit the
copy, and keep the copy out of git (.gitignore already covers *.private.md;
Keys the app reads: done-ISO (ticks, array of block ids) · ovr-ISO (skips)
movein-ISO (moved blocks) · runlog-ISO · wt-<lift> (gym weights) · recal · hr.
Run log entry: { sec, hr, km?, temp?, halfPaceSec?, hr2? }
sec = total run seconds · hr = average bpm · km overrides the plan distance
temp = air temperature °C (without it every pace-at-HR read is a weather read)
halfPaceSec + hr2 = the two extra long-run steppers that give decoupling
